library_name: Stock Optical Element Library - Raytraceable v2 with Shalom simple stock singlets
intended_use: Locked stock-element prototype mode for LensBuilderAI. Every entry is meant to be insertable/raytraceable because it has a complete published surface prescription.
important_notes: Verify supplier prices, availability, coatings, and sign convention before ordering or machining.
All catalog elements should be locked in the UI; only air gaps/spacers and orientation/order should be editable.
Do not treat this as a certified optical design file; it is a practical prototyping database assembled from public supplier tables.
v2 appends Shalom EO simple stock singlets: N-BK7 PCX uncoated, N-BK7 PCV coated/uncoated, and UVFS PCV λ/10 coated/uncoated.
